owner_acceptance.context: On 2026-10-18 at 00:56:35 KST (2026-10-17 15:56:35 UTC), after disclosure that native tuner and full product CI had passed, that the separate Windows candidate Defender update had timed out and was being retried, and that actual Studio One/DAW acceptance remained unverified, the owner explicitly instructed proceeding through publication. This renews publication authorization for the current integrated 1.3.2-beta.1 beta candidate with the existing disclosed validation gaps. It does not report personal DAW/listening testing, assert success of the pending Windows security retry, or waive any exact-source CI requirement.
owner_acceptance.scope: Publish 1.3.2-beta.1 from exact product source 3bec6c70a50bbb4021dcc6133f37e0c2fb3e9e58 only after the official publisher verifies every required latest exact-source workflow, package and artifact. The reviewed Product run 39036409533 attempt 1 has a source-bound strict report of 21 PASS / 107 unexecuted BLOCKED checks, including 42 blocked strict hard gates; preserve that report and every individually disclosed validation gap. Keep the existing transpose deferrals, signing/notarization limitations, real DI/listening and actual DAW/device acceptance gaps. Preserve the 290 ms tuner acquisition/settling and accuracy requirements. No unperformed or failed test is promoted to PASS, no required workflow is waived, and no validation rule, platform coverage or waiver inventory is changed. Pending or failed Windows candidate/Defender verification continues to block publication until the required workflow actually succeeds.
